service.method: SELECT BMMA.MODULE , BMMA.DESCRIPTION , BMMA.PARENT , BMMA.SORT , BMMA.ALIAS , CMAM.HOUSE_CODE , BMMA.OPTIONS FROM SBMMA BMMA LEFT JOIN SCMAM CMAM ON CMAM.MODULE = BMMA.MODULE LEFT JOIN SBMMA BMMA2 ON BMMA2.ALIAS = ${ALIAS} AND BMMA2.PARENT = ${PARENT} WHERE BMMA.PARENT = ${PARENT} AND BMMA.ALIAS != ${ALIAS} AND CMAM.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CAST(BMMA.OPTIONS AS INT) > CAST(BMMA2.OPTIONS AS INT) ORDER BY CAST(BMMA.OPTIONS AS INT) ASC
